items.subject: Heavy tactical combat machete knife, side view with the blade pointing right: dark brushed steel full-tang bolo blade with a satin polished cutting edge and small sawback teeth on the spine, brass S-shaped crossguard, contoured black textured grip with three brass rivets and a lanyard loop

Fictional futuristic military service pistol, side view with the muzzle pointing left: machined two-tone gunmetal slide with angled cocking serrations and a ported compensator, black polymer frame with a stippled raked grip, under-barrel laser module with a small cyan lens, small green glowing sight dots, extended magazine

Fictional futuristic pulse carbine rifle, side view with the muzzle pointing left: machined gunmetal receiver with a top rail, slotted lattice barrel shroud and a multi-port muzzle brake, black polymer buttstock with a cheek riser, raked pistol grip, angled foregrip, curved box magazine, small glowing cyan display panel on the side

Fictional shoulder-fired recoilless rocket launcher, side view with the front opening pointing right: olive drab composite launch tube with steel clamp collars, flared steel exhaust bell at the rear, two black pistol grips underneath, padded shoulder rest, carry handle, side-mounted targeting optic with a blue coated lens

Original bunker guard soldier: olive ballistic helmet with flipped-up night vision goggles and headset ear cups, woodland camouflage combat shirt and trousers, coyote tan plate carrier vest with magazine pouches and a small radio, olive elbow and knee pads, fingerless tan shooting gloves, black combat boots, stern face, empty hands

Original heavily armored heavy-weapons trooper: bulky olive and slate-grey bomb-disposal style armor suit with thick padded plates and a high blast collar, full-face armored helmet with a dark steel visor, ammunition belts across the chest, armored gauntlets, heavy black boots, broad and hulking, empty hands

Original towering scarred bunker commander, huge and broad: long charcoal grey military greatcoat with crimson lapels and crimson epaulettes, dark slate armored chest cuirass over the coat, black leather cross-belt and officer belt, tall polished black jackboots, crimson peaked officer cap with a plain brass badge, black eyepatch, short dark stubble, black leather gloves, compact armored backpack with two small antennas, empty hands

Original armored military attack dog: muscular lean dark sable black and tan short-haired guard dog with cropped pointed ears, wearing an olive tactical harness vest with two side pouches and a black collar, alert stance
Fictional compact military assault carbine: dark gunmetal receiver with a quad-rail handguard, collapsible black stock, curved magazine, angled foregrip, small reflex sight, flash suppressor
Fictional heavy six-barrel rotary machine gun: cluster of six long steel barrels, bulky dark olive motor housing, top carry handle, rear twin grips, ammunition belt feed chute

Wide heavy sliding steel bunker blast door panel: one flat rectangular riveted dark grey steel slab, slightly wider than it is tall and only a hand thick, clean straight edges, yellow and black hazard stripes along the bottom edge, flush recessed locking wheel, reinforced cross braces, scratches and grime, no frame, no rubble
Industrial corrugated steel roller shutter door in a heavy steel frame, flat front face, olive grey paint, hazard-striped bottom rail, grime and rust streaks
